str_1_a_second_model_also_analyses_help: 1 = a second model also analyses every recording ({menu:Model comparison}); 0 = off.
str_a_change_of_location_is_already_help: A change of location is already running
str_a_point_within_this_distance_of_help: A point within this distance of the centre is this location: the phone's GPS, a restored backup, the boot check (at least {ip} km)
str_a_text_without_this_tag_gets_a_help: A text without this tag gets a Location line under its first line.
str_about_16_gb_a_day_less_written_help: about 16 GB a day less written to the disk, the main wear of an SD card on a station that runs day and night.
str_advantages_and_disadvantages_of_help: Advantages and disadvantages of the RAM drive (experimental!)
str_allow_the_browser_to_use_your_help: Allow the browser to use your location when it asks.
str_an_unticked_species_stays_out_help: An unticked species stays out of the eBird file and of the e-mail sent from here; the weekly schedule follows the station's species lists.
str_analyse_the_recordings_already_help: Analyse the recordings already made here
str_another_service_command_is_help: Another service command is still running. Try again in a moment.
str_are_you_sure_you_want_to_help: Are you sure you want to shutdown?
str_are_you_sure_you_want_to_reboot_help: Are you sure you want to reboot?
str_are_you_sure_you_want_to_update_help: Are you sure you want to update?
str_at_every_boot_the_station_asks_help: At every boot the station asks whether to change the location when its position (taken from the network, city level, not from the GPS: hence {km} km) has changed.
str_audio_files_kept_for_this_days_help: Audio files kept for this species by the nightly clean-up (the last {days} days, PURGE_RECENT_DAYS, and the protected ones always stay); 0 = keep all; empty = the global number.
str_automatic_restarts_since_the_help: automatic restarts since the last start: {list}
str_birdnet_pi_cannot_be_put_back_help: BirdNET-Pi cannot be put back: its program was removed when its history was moved into BirdSuite. To go back, install BirdNET-Pi again, take the detections along with {menu:Backup/Import} › Export (BirdNET format), and use its settings from {file} (Download the BirdNET-Pi settings).
str_birdnet_pi_is_back_the_station_help: BirdNET-Pi is back. The station restarts now; open it again in a minute or two.
str_birdsuite_was_installed_over_copy_he: BirdSuite was installed over BirdNET-Pi on {date}. BirdNET-Pi is kept as it was, so you can go back to it.
str_birdsuite_was_installed_over_move_he: BirdSuite was installed over BirdNET-Pi on {date}. Its database and clips were moved into BirdSuite and its program was removed; its settings are kept in {file}.
str_change_the_theme_of_each_help: Change the theme of each location in {menu:Locations}.
str_changing_it_only_changes_the_names_h: Changing it only changes the names shown; the database, the lists and the clips keep the scientific names, and nothing restarts.
str_chunks_waiting_of_audio_the_help: {n} chunks waiting ({age} of audio), the analysis is not keeping up
str_click_a_country_to_zoom_in_then_help: Click a country to zoom in, then click the place.
str_click_advanced_and_then_proceed_help: Click "Advanced" and then "Proceed" or "Accept the risk and continue".
str_click_the_cells_to_see_only_help: Click the cells to see only that species in this panel.
str_click_the_map_or_drag_the_pin_help: Click the map (or drag the pin) to fill latitude and longitude. Map, relief, satellite or hybrid view at the top right (needs internet).
str_click_the_place_double_click_help: {country}: click the place (double-click for the whole world).
str_clips_older_than_an_hour_help: {n} clips older than an hour waiting for the upload
str_clips_protected_automatically_help: {auto} clips protected automatically (best {top} per species + confirmed), {manual} locked by hand, list of {date}
str_confidence_the_score_the_model_help: Confidence: the score the model gave this sound for the species, 0 to 100%. It is kept when it reaches at least the minimum confidence (or the manual confidence of the species).
str_coordinates_from_the_network_help: Coordinates from the network position{place}; fix them later in {menu:Locations}.
str_coordinates_of_the_current_help: Coordinates of the current location; fix them later in {menu:Locations}.
str_day_of_the_weekly_ebird_e_mail_help: Day of the weekly eBird e-mail: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday.
str_days_left_of_the_test_period: {n} of the {days} days of the test period left (until {date}).
str_delete_the_saved_name_q: Delete the saved name {name}? It leaves the picklist.
str_detect_at_boot_whether_the_help: Detect at boot whether the station changed location
str_e_mail_is_not_set_up_or_not_help: E-mail is not set up or not confirmed: {menu:E-mail}.
str_ebird_e_mail_daily_every_day_help: eBird e-mail: daily = every day the previous day, weekly = on its day the last seven days.
str_fields_and_yyyy_mm_dd_any_date_help: Fields: {start} and {end} (YYYY-MM-DD), any date pattern as {start:YYYYMMDD} or {end:YY-MM-DD}, {week}, {year}, {station}, {id}, {location}.
str_files_or_folders_under_can_be_help: {n} files or folders under {dir} can be changed by anyone on the device (chmod -R o-w)
str_filter_of_the_weekly_ebird_e_help: Filter of the weekly eBird e-mail: confirmed = only the species confirmed by ear, minconf = from the minimum confidence and the confirmed ones, all = every detection.
str_filter_the_ebird_page_opens_help: Filter the eBird page opens with: confirmed, minconf (from EBIRD_PAGE_MIN_CONF) or all.
str_finished_with_an_error_code_see_help: Finished with an error (code {code}). See the messages above.
str_for_the_exact_position_use_the_help: For the exact position use the GPS icon on the map, from a phone or computer.
str_go_back_to_birdnet_pi_help: Go back to BirdNET-Pi? BirdSuite is stopped and switched off, BirdNET-Pi is put back as it was and the station restarts. Detections made with BirdSuite stay in BirdSuite; take them along first with {menu:Backup/Import} › Export (BirdNET format).
str_hear_bands_help:
Green band
Top: the highest song that matters
Bottom: high-pass filter, cuts the sounds below it (wind, traffic, hum)
Orange band
Maps the high songs into a band you can hear
str_hear_high_songs_lower_help: For hearing loss, on this device: what goes to the speaker is lowered, as the frequency lowering of a hearing aid (the live sound and the clips); the recordings and the analysis do not change. The gear beside it sets it.
str_hover_for_the_numbers_click_a_help: Hover for the numbers; click a name for the species page.
str_how_many_sounds_confirmed_by_help: How many sounds confirmed by ear of each species? (1 to 20)
str_if_the_analysis_stops_the_help: if the analysis stops, the recordings pile up in RAM (about 700 MB an hour) and can fill it in an hour or two on a 2 GB Pi; a power cut loses the last seconds not yet analysed (the detections already saved stay).
str_impact_a_validation_marker_only_help: Impact: a validation marker only; detection, filters and notifications do not change.
str_impact_it_can_be_detected_all_help: Impact: it can be detected all year; if it does not occur here, more false detections are possible. The minimum confidence and the species list still apply.
str_impact_it_is_detected_again_help: Impact: it is detected again whenever it passes the minimum confidence and the filters.
str_impact_it_is_only_detected_in_help: Impact: it is only detected in the weeks the model expects it here.
str_impact_no_new_detections_help: Impact: no new detections, notifications or recordings for it; its past detections are kept. Untick to detect it again.
str_in_the_ebird_file_and_the_e_help: In the eBird file and the e-mail sent from here
str_interrupted_the_change_help: interrupted (the station restarted or the change was stopped)
str_it_keeps_the_recordings_waiting_help: It keeps the recordings waiting for the analysis ({dir}, 15-second files of about 2.9 MB) in RAM instead of on the card or SSD. Turning it on or off restarts the station.
str_level_help: How much of the station the menu and the pages show; a change asks for the login
str_light_grey_a_week_without_any_help: Light grey = a week without any recording.
str_listen_to_the_stations_help: Listen to the station's microphone live
str_location_in_the_ebird_file: Location name in the eBird file:
str_location_name_of_the_ebird_help: The location name of every checklist of the eBird file: the last name used is kept, the picklist has the names used before.
str_location_names_used_before_help: The location names used before on the eBird page, newest first: its picklist.
str_locations_shown_in_the_table_help: Locations shown in the table and the cards
str_manual_confidence_of_the_help: Manual confidence of the species that replaced the minimum confidence when it was detected
str_minimum_confidence_the_ebird_help: Minimum confidence the eBird page opens with (0-0.99).
str_move_old_sounds_to_the_external_help: move old sounds to the external folder
str_no_backup_made_on_this_station_help: no backup made on this station yet ({menu})
str_no_bird_heard_in_this_period_at_help: No bird heard in this period at this confidence.
str_no_chunks_in_streamdata_the_help: no chunks in StreamData, the recording is not running
str_no_detection_for_of_daylight_help: no detection for {age} of daylight although recording and analysis run: check the microphone
str_no_map_available_offline_type_help: No map available offline: type the coordinates.
str_no_program_file_can_be_changed_help: no program file can be changed by other users
str_no_restart_of_the_recording_in_help: no restart of the recording in the last 24 h
str_no_sound_confirmed_by_ear_is_help: No sound confirmed by ear is left on the disk for this period.
str_no_species_in_this_period_with_help: No species in this period with this filter.
str_no_usb_sound_card_microphone_help: no USB sound card, microphone unplugged? (the station stops until it is back)
str_not_computed_yet_it_is_built_at_help: not computed yet: it is built at the first notification of the day
str_not_synchronised_detection_help: not synchronised: detection times may be wrong
str_numbers_detections_the_e_mail_help: Numbers = detections; the e-mail also brings the weather of each day (Open-Meteo, N/A without internet).
str_offline_map_no_internet_click_a_help: Offline map (no internet): click a country to zoom in, then click the place. Type the exact coordinates when you know them.
str_one_ebird_file_per_day_help: One eBird file per day, in a zip: import each file.
str_open_the_ebird_page_with_this_help: Open the eBird page with this filter and minimum confidence
str_pct_used_gb_free_at_pct_the_help: {used}% used, {gb} GB free; at {limit}% the station will {action}
str_position_sent_to_the_station_page: Position sent to the station page.
str_possible_once_the_birdnet_pi_help: Possible once the BirdNET-Pi detections are imported.
str_probability_of_how_likely_help: Probability of occurrence at the location: how likely the location model finds this species here in the week of the detection (as in {menu:Species}). Green when above the minimum probability of occurrence at the location, red when below.
str_probability_of_this_week_help: Probability of occurrence at the location this week:
str_recordings_failed_to_be_help: {n} recordings failed to be reported and were kept in {dir}
str_remove_the_birdnet_pi_leftovers_help: Remove the BirdNET-Pi leftovers? The kept folders and the settings archive are deleted for good ({size}). Going back to BirdNET-Pi is then no longer possible.
str_restart_s_of_the_recording_in_help: {n} restart(s) of the recording in the last 24 h because of empty clips, the last at {time}
str_running_do_not_close_this_page: Running, do not close this page…
str_show_all_pages_help: Every page in this browser, whatever the level
str_something_needs_attention_see_help: Something needs attention, see the red lines.
str_species_confirmed_by_ear_from_to: Species confirmed by ear from {a} to {b}: {n}.
str_species_detected_from_to_every_help: Species detected from {a} to {b}: {n}, every detection not answered No.
str_species_detected_from_to_from_help: Species detected from {a} to {b}: {n}, from {pct}% of confidence or confirmed by ear.
str_species_in_the_table_the_ebird_help: Species in the table, the eBird files and the e-mail
str_station_minimum_probability_of_help: Station minimum probability of occurrence at the location: {pct}% (below it the species is left out)
str_still_the_birdsuite_change_help: still the factory password birdsuite: change the default web password in {menu}
str_subject_of_the_weekly_ebird_e_help: Subject of the weekly eBird e-mail and name of its file: {start} {end} (YYYY-MM-DD, or a pattern such as {start:YYYYMMDD}), {week}, {year}, {station}, {id}, {location}.
str_the_analysis_is_stopped_so_help: The analysis is stopped, so {n} recordings made here wait: start it ({menu:Status} › Services) and change the location again.
str_the_analysis_of_the_last_help: The analysis of the last recordings takes too long ({n} left): the location was not changed.
str_the_best_sounds_confirmed_by_help: The best sounds confirmed by ear of every bird, to add to the imported checklists with eBird's Add media
str_the_birdnet_pi_detections_are_help: The BirdNET-Pi detections and clips are imported as soon as the station has its location (after the first setup).
str_the_browser_blocked_the_window_help: The browser blocked the window: allow pop-ups for the station and try again.
str_the_browser_gives_the_devices_help: The browser gives the device's position only to secure (https) pages, so the station switches https on for a moment.
str_the_e_mail_did_not_go_out_check_help: The e-mail did not go out: check {menu:E-mail}.
str_the_e_mail_subject_and_the_file_help: The e-mail subject and the file name.
str_the_ebird_file_is_attached_help: The eBird file is attached: eBird › Submit › Import data, eBird Record Format (Extended).
str_the_external_folder_of_full_help: The external folder of FULL_DISK = external (a mounted share or disk, writable by the station user).
str_the_first_or_that_the_help: The first time on this device the browser warns that the connection is not private or that the site may be unsafe ("Your connection is not private", "Warning: Potential Security Risk").
str_the_import_of_the_birdnet_pi_help: The import of the BirdNET-Pi detections is running; its progress shows in {menu:Backup/Import}.
str_the_import_of_the_birdnet_pi_stopped: The import of the BirdNET-Pi detections stopped: {error}
str_the_last_send_failed_at_retried_help: the last send failed at {time}, retried every 5 minutes
str_the_location_the_detection_was_help: The location the detection was recorded at.
str_the_network_position_is_about_help: The network position is about this far off, so a smaller distance is never taken as a move
str_the_protection_list_has_not_help: the protection list has not been built yet (it is built before the first purge)
str_the_recording_did_not_start_help: The recording did not start again: check the microphone and {menu:Status} › Services.
str_the_recording_was_not_running_before: the recording was not running before
str_the_service_keeps_stopping_see_help: the service keeps stopping, see its log
str_the_species_from_this_help: The species of {menu:Night-only species} are dropped from this many minutes after sunrise.
str_the_species_that_only_sing_at_help: The species that only sing at night: their detections are dropped by day.
str_the_species_until_this_help: The species of {menu:Night-only species} are dropped until this many minutes before sunset.
str_the_station_is_restarting_its_help: The station is restarting its web server, waiting…
str_the_station_moment_and_help: The station switches https on for a moment and opens a small window: accept the station's certificate once and allow the location.
str_the_station_works_with_warnings_help: The station works, with warnings below.
str_the_steps_go_on_at_the_station_help: The steps go on at the station even if this page is closed.
str_the_system_journal_is_kept_this_help: The system journal is kept this many days (7, 30, 90, 365, or 0 = manual: no time limit) and at most 200 MB (1 GB for 365 or manual); the rotated files of /var/log are compressed ({menu:Disk Space}).
str_the_test_playback_location_help:
The Test / Playback location sends no notifications and no records to repositories.
Delete test records in {menu:Data}.
str_the_update_failed_code_see_the_help: The update failed (code {code}). See the messages above.
str_the_window_closes_by_itself_the_help: The window closes by itself, the position fills the map and https goes off again.
str_then_allow_the_browser_to_use_help: Then allow the browser to use your location.
str_this_is_expected_the_station_help: This is expected: the station makes its own certificate, which no public authority can sign for a device in your home network.
str_this_will_reboot_are_you_sure: This will reboot, are you sure?
str_time_of_the_weekly_ebird_e_mail_help: Time of the weekly eBird e-mail (HH:MM).
str_to_import_the_ebird_file_help: To import the eBird file: eBird › Submit › Import data, file format "eBird Record Format (Extended)".
str_type_these_coordinates_on_the_help: Type these coordinates on the station page:
str_updating_do_not_close_this_page: Updating, do not close this page…
str_usb_sound_card_s_present_help: {n} USB sound card(s) present; recording device {device}
str_wait_until_the_import_of_the_help: Wait until the import of the BirdNET-Pi detections ends.
str_waiting_for_the_position_in_the_help: Waiting for the position in the small window…
str_warning_your_latitude_and_help: WARNING: Your latitude and longitude are not set properly. Please do so now in {menu:Locations}.
str_warning_your_latitude_is_not_help: WARNING: Your latitude is not set properly. Please do so now in {menu:Locations}.
str_warning_your_longitude_is_not_help: WARNING: Your longitude is not set properly. Please do so now in {menu:Locations}.
str_weekly_ebird_e_mail_1_the_help: Weekly eBird e-mail: 1 = the species confirmed by ear of the last seven days and their eBird file go by e-mail every week.
str_what_it_accepted_even_help: What it does: the species is accepted even when its probability of occurrence at the location this week is below the minimum.
str_what_it_does_marks_the_species_help: What it does: marks the species as confirmed, you have checked that it really occurs at this station.
str_what_it_does_the_location_help: What it does: the location filter applies to the species again.
str_what_it_does_the_species_is_no_help: What it does: the species is no longer marked as confirmed.
str_what_it_does_the_species_leaves_help: What it does: the species leaves the exclude list.
str_what_it_never_detected_help: What it does: the species is never detected again (exclude list).
str_when_the_disk_reaches_purge_help: When the disk reaches PURGE_THRESHOLD: purge = delete the oldest clips, keep = stop the recording, external = move the oldest sounds to FULL_DISK_PATH.
str_when_the_external_folder_cannot_help: When the external folder cannot be used (not mounted, not writable, full, same disk): keep = stop the recording, purge = delete the oldest clips.
str_with_minconf_the_lowest_help: With minconf, the lowest confidence of a detection to count in the weekly eBird e-mail (0-0.99).
str_without_an_answer_it_stays_at_help: Without an answer it stays at the current location in
str_worth_it_with_an_sd_card_and_4_help: Worth it with an SD card and 4 GB of RAM or more; with an SSD the gain is small.
str_you_cannot_access_the_web_term: You cannot access the web terminal
str_you_must_be_authenticated_to_change_: You must be authenticated to change the migration from BirdNET-Pi.
str_you_must_be_authenticated_to_update: You must be authenticated to update.
str_you_must_change_the_services_help: You must be authenticated to change the services.
str_you_must_download_backup_help: You must be authenticated to download backup files.
str_you_must_download_the_ebird_help: You must be authenticated to download the eBird file.
str_you_must_read_the_station_help: You must be authenticated to read the station health.
str_you_must_upload_backup_help: You must be authenticated to upload backup files.
